messages:
miguel: Quick sync — prepping quant precision toggles for the rollout today. Plan: enable FP16 by default where supported, then gated INT8 for cost-sensitive models, and keep INT4 behind experimental flag. Canary audience: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated checks. Need sign-off on guardrails + who will watch metrics.
cheng: quick q — are we doing model-level flags or route-level?
miguel: model-level for now (per model version). We'll allow route overrides later. Simpler to rollback per model if perf regresses.
sara: I'll do review for the runtime wiring. Can you post the flag config?
miguel: config snippet:```json
{
  "quant_precision_rollout": {
    "models": {
      "gpt-small-v2": {"enabled": true, "default": "fp16", "canary_pct": 5, "int8_allowed": true},
      "embedder-1": {"enabled": true, "default": "int8", "canary_pct": 5, "int4_allowed": false}
    },
    "global_guardrails": {"p99_latency_ms": 200, "latency_increase_pct": 15, "quality_regression_threshold": 0.02}
  }
}```
nana: Guardrails look fine. For quality_regression_threshold: is that relative perplexity or eval-set accuracy?
miguel: it's eval-set delta on the smoke prompt set (we run eval job every canary step). If delta > 0.02 we auto-roll back.
kevin: ops: please ensure canary uses isolated pool so it doesn't affect capacity metrics for general traffic.
ops: will do. We'll pin to dedicated pool with 1 GPU for canary and add a capacity buffer in autoscaler.
oncall-bot: Incident watch enabled for this rollout: monitors -> [p99_latency, error_rate, token_cost, model_output_quality]. Auto-alert threshold: p99 > 220ms or error_rate > 0.5%.
sara: Also add a short smoke test in Deploy CI that runs: `python tests/smoke/quant_smoke.py --model {model}` and checks F1 and avg latency. I'll add the test.
miguel: thanks. Two open asks: 1) who will monitor first canary window (1h)? 2) who flips INT8 flag after FP16 proves stable?
cheng: I can own the first hour. I'll be on pager rotation.
nana: I can flip INT8 after the 4h stability window unless any alerts. Will post PR to feature-flags once FP16 is at 25%.
kevin: We'll also run a batch of offline evals for INT8 vs FP16 for samples that historically regress (long-tail). I'll queue them now.
ops: FYI: rolling back is `feature-flags set quant_precision_rollout.models.<model>.enabled false` — we also have a shortcut in console to disable for all models.
miguel: great. One more guardrail: token_cost delta > 8% triggers rollback. Add it to global_guardrails?
nana: agreed. I'll update the config and also add a dashboard tile for token_cost per model.
sara: LGTM on runtime changes, will ship review by EOD.
miguel: thanks team. I'll start canary at 15:00 UTC. Ping here when you see anomalies. :thumbsup:
cheng: noted. will post a short summary at +30m and +1h.
kevin: queued offline evals, ETA 45m.
nana: updated flag config in PR #482 — added token_cost guardrail and explicit rollback rule.
miguel: linking PR and canary run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 and will kick canary shortly.
ops: canary pool ready. Load tests pass.
oncall-bot: Canary started for models: gpt-small-v2 (5%) at 1742003582. Monitoring live.
cheng: saw a small spike in p99 at +18m (from 160 -> 190ms) but still under threshold. No errors.
kevin: offline eval shows INT8 F1 drop 0.007 on long-tail set — under threshold. I'll keep watching.
miguel: if anything crosses guardrail, we hit rollback and open incident. Everyone thumbs up on final? :eyes:
sara: :thumbsup:
nana: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
ops: ready to rollback if needed.
miguel: ok launching step to 25% in 40m if stable. I'll update thread then.
